posts.title: Too Old for a Story Box, Too Young for a Phone: Building Studio Pocket
posts.description: Our house runs on Yoto. Pop a card in, the story plays, job done. But I wanted something for the next stage: the same simplicity, in a player that fits in a pocket and feels a bit more grown up. I wasn't the only one feeling it. posts.title: I Rewrote The Beano So My Five-Year-Old Could Read It
posts.description: My oldest daughter's favourite time of the week is when her Beano lands on the doormat. It's also my youngest daughter's least favourite time of the week, because her playmate disappears into a corner to devour it for the rest of the day.
